children: New Circle Capital Solutions LP disclosed a 4.6% stake in ONE Nuclear Energy Inc.'s common stock. The position stems from purchases on Sept. 23, 2026, tied to the SPAC closing and was reported in a Schedule 13D filed on Sept. 30, 2026. The fund reversed redemptions under a forward purchase deal, briefly holding about 25.4% of the SPAC’s Class A shares before dilution at closing reduced its stake to 4.6% of the combined company.

The fund bought 4,987,103 shares through a Forward Purchase Agreement to "act as a potential financing pathway for the company." It reversed redemptions, waived its own redemption rights, and received a cash prepayment after closing equal to the agreed per-share price.

After the merger closed, the agreement lets the fund "terminate the transaction in whole or in part" on any trading day by giving notice and selecting the number of shares. The group says it has no current plans for board changes or other control actions but can buy or sell securities as circumstances evolve.

New Circle Capital Solutions LP is a Delaware limited partnership that acquires, holds, and disposes of investments in public securities. NCCS Management, LLC manages the fund and operates as an exempt reporting adviser, with co-managing partners Osman H. Ahmed and Walter V. Arnold. The team focuses on event-driven opportunities, including SPAC-related financing such as forward purchase and redemption reversal structures.
